texts: Bulky mesothelioma that invades the fissures of the lung cannot be peeled off it.
With chemotherapy, the most appropriate operation is extrapleural pneumonectomy: the lung is removed in one block with the pleura, the diaphragm and the pericardium: D is the answer.
It is only for patients with enough cardiopulmonary reserve to live without that lung.
Memory hook: the rind dives into every crack, so Zoro lifts out the sack, the lining and the floor in one block.
